title: Pokus host profile
description: Report written by pinka-preflight to /etc/pinka/host-profile.json (pokus-infrastructure BUILD_PROMPT §2). generated_at is the only volatile field.

repo_commit.description: Commit of the pokus-infrastructure checkout that ran preflight, if known.

exit_code.description: Exit code that belongs to the outcome.

tier.description: Worst of the OS, architecture and environment tiers.

os_tier.description: Tier of the matched OS rule.

arch_tier.description: Tier of the matched architecture rule.

provider.description: Provider role that applies to this host.

parent_release.description: Release identity used for third-party repositories (parent for derivatives).

signals.description: Every signal used for classification and its value.

driver_cuda.description: The highest CUDA version the loaded NVIDIA driver supports (major.minor, from nvidia-smi; on WSL2 the Windows driver's).

install_driver.description: The host's install_nvidia_driver setting given to preflight (--nvidia-driver): auto, manual or skip.

pci_device.description: PCI vendor and device ID of the first NVIDIA GPU on the PCI bus (bare metal, VM passthrough); null elsewhere.

open_module_drivers.description: The pinned NVIDIA driver releases whose open kernel module supports this GPU (versions.lock.yml nvidia_driver_gpus); with install_nvidia_driver: auto a driver is installed only for one of them (BUILD_PROMPT §2.2, §10.1).

proprietary_only_drivers.description: The pinned NVIDIA driver releases that support this GPU only with their proprietary kernel module (Maxwell, Pascal, Volta: below compute capability 7.5), so no driver is installed for it; empty for a GPU only a legacy branch supports or the list does not name.

plan.description: defaults, or the plan file given with --plan (§2.3).

choices.description: The effective plan: the operator's choices that size the lab (preflight/schema/plan.schema.json).

switches.description: The feature switches of the plan on this host (§2.3): what they leave on, and the training cap.

serves.description: vLLM, its images and the selected model are installed and counted on this node.

runs.description: Where training jobs run on this node: on the GPU, the CPU-only variant, or none (the GPU arbiter refuses every run).

memory_max.description: The training cap as training_caps.memory_max writes it; the play uses it where memory_max is auto.

memory_max_basis.description: computed: memory_max auto, from MemTotal and what else runs; configured: the setting.

memory_gib.description: MemTotal against the floor and the required and recommended memory computed from the choices; each nominal threshold is compared at the tolerance.

cpu_threads.description: The estimated CPU use of the running parts (information; the threshold is the matrix's cpu_threads).

disk.description: The disk known at install, per mount point, item by item.

growth.description: What grows with use below the research space; never a reason to refuse.

days_until_full.description: The day the disk fills at this rate; null if the retention keeps it below the free space for ten years.

pool.description: The Incus pool's size (§2.3): a loop file of incus_pool_size, or computed for auto (the golden images and the concurrent targets' root disks with a margin, limited by the free space where the loop file goes); null on an inference node.

disabled_features.description: Features whose absence makes the host degraded, with their research impact.

remediation.description: What makes the feature available, when the matrix names it (for example the driver update of gpu_inference).

storage_backend.description: Backend for the Incus pool; null means no quota-capable storage.

components.description: Components that may exist before pinka, with their origin from the install record (/var/lib/pinka/install-record.json) or, without one, from pinka's marks (BUILD_PROMPT §2.2, §7.21).

install_record.description: The host has an install record.

installed.description: The component is on the host.

version.description: Its version, if it could be read.

origin.description: pinka: pinka installed or joined it; pre-existing: it was there before pinka, which uses it as it is and never changes it; null: not installed.

cdi.description: CDI is on (docker info lists CDI spec directories; without a running daemon: daemon.json and the version).

installed.description: The component is on the host.

version.description: Its version, if it could be read.

origin.description: pinka: pinka installed or joined it; pre-existing: it was there before pinka, which uses it as it is and never changes it; null: not installed.

logged_in.description: The node is logged in (BackendState Running).

hostname.description: The node's host name on the tailnet.

key_expiry.description: When the node's key expires; null when key expiry is off.

installed.description: The component is on the host.

version.description: Its version, if it could be read.

origin.description: pinka: pinka installed or joined it; pre-existing: it was there before pinka, which uses it as it is and never changes it; null: not installed.

installed.description: The component is on the host.

version.description: Its version, if it could be read.

origin.description: pinka: pinka installed or joined it; pre-existing: it was there before pinka, which uses it as it is and never changes it; null: not installed.

docker_compat.description: How Podman provides Docker's command or socket, if it does.

access.description: The access to the host that existed before the install (BUILD_PROMPT §2.2 "Pre-existing access", §7.5): the listeners outside the lab, the firewall manager, the login accounts that are not pinka's and the access path of the install's session. The firewall keeps it as found.

host.description: dedicated: no listener besides sshd and the admitted ones, and every login account is a configured researcher; shared otherwise.

session.description: The access path of the install: SSH (the server address and port of SSH_CONNECTION of the nearest process up the tree that has it, its login account, and whether the address is on the tailnet) or the console.

address.description: The server address the session reached.

port.description: The server port the session reached.

user.description: The session's login account, or null when it is not in /etc/passwd.

tailnet.description: The server address is on the tailnet.

listeners.description: Every non-loopback TCP and UDP listener that is not the lab's.

address.description: The local address; 0.0.0.0 and :: listen on every address.

process.description: The process name, or null when preflight cannot see it (it does not run as root); sshd for a socket that activates the SSH server.

unit.description: The process's systemd unit, or the socket unit of a socket systemd holds.

admitted.description: pinka's strict input policy accepts this traffic anyway on every interface (the DHCP and DHCPv6 clients, Tailscale's WireGuard port).

accounts.description: The login accounts that are not pinka's: a UID in the login range of /etc/login.defs and a login shell.

reasons.description: What makes the host shared; empty on a dedicated host.

degraded_reasons.description: Why the host is degraded besides disabled features: memory below the recommended value for the choices (§2.3).

planned_actions.description: Actions bootstrap carries out with the operator's consent instead of stopping (for example the MOK enrollment of an NVIDIA driver on a Secure Boot host); each is also listed among the warnings.

overrides.description: Operator overrides; carried into every environment fingerprint.

mount.description: The mount point of its filesystem (df's target).

free_bytes.description: The free space in bytes, which the requirements compare (§2.3).

installed.description: The component is on the host.

version.description: Its version, if it could be read.

origin.description: pinka: pinka installed or joined it; pre-existing: it was there before pinka, which uses it as it is and never changes it; null: not installed.

detail.description: How the numbers follow from the choices.

present.description: Already on the host: it needs no more space.

cap_gib.description: Where its retention stops it; null if nothing does.
